latestVersion.changelog:
job-analysis-intro v1.0.0

- Initial release for assisting job analysis (工作分析) study discussions, focused on Chapter 1 of  Job and Work Analysis by Brannick/Levine/Morgeson et al.
- Responds contextually to user queries about core concepts (job, position, KSAO, duty/task/activity), main uses, project planning, and terminology differentiation.
- Implements a progressive disclosure approach—diagnose user’s needs and level first, provide minimal necessary info per interaction, and draw on textbook examples when needed.
- Seamlessly guides users to relevant reference materials for in-depth details (e.g., descriptors, methods, real-world cases) as questions arise.
- Distinguishes the scope: covers only Chapter 1 introduction; refers out for later-chapter methods/concepts.
